0 My City: Roll & Build My City: Roll & Build is a dice game in which over four chapters, each with three episodes, you create a unique city. The roll of the dice shows everyone which building to draw on their game pad, and from episode to episode, you have to face new challenges. First the land is developed and later gold is found. This brings bandits into your city who must be surrounded and taken into custody. You can play through the campaign or pick your favorite individual episodes or chapters to play over and over again. Number of players: 1 - 6 Game duration: 39 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play My City: Roll & Build and 1414 other games online. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Overview My City Roll & Build is a campaign game. There are 4 chapters, each with 3 thematically related episodes; so 12 episodes (mini games/rounds) in all. For a full campaign you work through each of the 12 episodes in order, scoring each episode, chapter and overall victory in turn. Only the basic rules are given here. New rules will be added during the game so look out for instructions at the start of each Episode and Chapter. [Rating: 1/10] Absolute garbage design compared to My City proper. You lose the ability to track what pieces are left in the deck that might appear, which means passing is just a push-your-luck black hole with no guarantee of getting that one piece you need. No catch up mechanics like the ones present in the regular game. And the maps and mechanics are significantly less interesting. This is just a dice game that is alllllll about the dice and nothing else and you have to play 12 times in a row to see who actually wins. [Rating: 2/10] My city has a slow start but the little restrictions that come from not being able to flip the tiles as well as the fixed deck make it great.  My city roll & build is a travesty.

[Rating: 2/10] Not a lot of excitement or energy here. Would be better with other people but feel like buddies would all get bored and lose interest. Not our type of game but I'm not a roll & write fan. Cute concept tho. Boring solo but probably annoying with analysis paralysis slowing you down with people.

[Rating: 3/10] It feels wrong to rate this game so low. In a vacuum this game isn't that bad but the original My City exists. This is simply worse than My City in nearly every way while also feeling highly repetitive of My City. Maybe this will work as an alternative for people new to the series but why would you get this when the better version is relatively inexpensive (and can be tried on BGA!). Ultimately this leaves me significantly worried about My Island. If Knizia has already run out of ideas what will he have left for another sequel?
